scenes.headline: How a phone message reaches your home GPU
scenes.sub: Intel's AI Playground Home Agent, read from its code
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Gunwale! Intel's AI Playground lets you message your own PC from your phone. Here is the path.

scenes.text: Your PC asks the chat service for new messages, so nothing on the internet ever has to connect to it.
scenes.say: The trick is direction. Your PC asks the chat service for messages. Nothing connects in.

steps.say: You type on your phone. The message waits on Telegram's or Slack's servers.
A Python service on your PC holds a request open and collects it.
The desktop app checks that service every two seconds, over loopback, with a secret token.
It runs the turn on local models. A small Qwen model plans, and ComfyUI draws on the Arc card.
Replies return the same way. Compute stays home; prompts and pictures cross the chat service.

left.title: The usual way
items: Forward a port or run a tunnel
Or route through a vendor relay
left.say: Reaching a home PC usually means a forwarded port, a tunnel, or a vendor relay.

right.title: Home Agent
items: Outbound only: long poll or socket
No Intel server in the path
right.say: Home Agent only connects outward, and no Intel server sits in the path.

scenes.title: One id is the whole key
scenes.say: Who may talk to it is one number.

items.say: In setup, you message your bot and press Detect. The app reads your chat id.
Every handler compares each sender against it. Slack uses one user id.
Anyone else is dropped before the model sees a word.
One catch. Detect can pick up a stranger, so check the test message reached you.

steps.say: Past the gate, a message drives an agent with tools, like Python inside Blender.
Tools are on by default. Only settings changes and downloads ask first, in the same chat.

scenes.label: of the repository's tests pass, run offline on a CPU
scenes.say: The project's tests pass offline, twenty eight of twenty eight.

scenes.text: The model stays home. The conversation, and the tools, belong to whoever holds the chat.
scenes.say: The model stays home. The chat, and its tools, belong to whoever holds it.

recap: The PC polls outward; no port opens
One chat id or user id is the key
Prompts and pictures transit the chat service
scenes.say: Outward polling, one id as the key, and a transcript that lives with the chat service.
